verdicts.evidence: DocLints.jl docs_build_skipped: "A refusal that also names an open round of a disabled instrument, or a round whose fixes were committed without it, fails the build." Gate.jl:80 `r.name in ignored && continue` precedes :committed; Gate.jl:82 `if !in_ci && head !== nothing && head != r.round["head"]`. Release.jl:108 and Doctor.jl:644 set GBG_DOCS_NO_SKIP. The same gate already refuses Pkg.test in this state.

The audited edit is a comment-only retarget in ext/GBGCodingToolsDocumenterExt.jl:51 ('freezes the build (`RULE.INST.FROZEN_MIDROUND`)' -> '(ARCHITECTURE D9)'); no code changed. D9 (ARCHITECTURE.md:490-494) states the skip: 'a round of a docs instrument is open prints `makedocs: SKIPPED` ... `GBG_DOCS_NO_SKIP` restores the refusal'. The rule (instruments.md:81) says only 'An instrument is never changed mid-round'.

Gate.jl: `r.name in ignored && continue` precedes both pushes; `:committed` is pushed only after `:open` and only `if !in_ci`, so GBG_ROUND (gbg round build) and CI never hit it. Contract texts scope the skip to "refusing only because a docs round is open" (DocLints.jl:22, index.md:28, ARCHITECTURE:491). rounds.md:55: the gate exists "so a fix pass cannot be committed around an open round". IMPLEMENTATION.md:90: a bare build under an open round "is refused by design".

47db044's only Design.jl change is one docstring line: "hat's own rubric should have caught it" -> "hat's persona should have caught it". The message itemizes that class: "cold-reader#1-4 ...; \"the rubric\" named". The new word is accurate: catalog/hats/README.md defines "`persona` (the prompt body)", and calibrate writes h["persona"] to each blind hat's payload. No code changed.

Gate.jl gate_problems: `r.name in ignored && continue` precedes both :open and :committed pushes (GBG_ROUND exempts both); :committed needs `!in_ci`, `in_ci = haskey(ENV, "CI")`. DocLints.jl docs_build_skipped skips only if `all(p -> first(p) == :open, ...)`; docstring: "a round whose fixes were committed without it, fails the build". IMPLEMENTATION.md:90-91: "A bare julia --project=docs docs/make.jl under an open round is refused by design".

Gate.jl frozen_rounds doc: "A build refused ONLY for these is frozen". gate_problems: `r.name in ignored && continue` precedes the :committed push, which needs `!in_ci && head != r.round["head"]`. Round builds use run_under_round (GBG_ROUND); release/doctor add GBG_DOCS_NO_SKIP; logs go to scratch_dir. Only a bare local build changes: before, it skipped with exit 0 and built nothing ("Nothing was built"). Now it fails with exit 1, and the gate CLI refuses the same state.
